question: Can Vega establish a difference in IQ, or only recall?

requirements.requiredFact: State the recall comparison and clarify that the excerpts do not establish an IQ difference.
requirements.quote: In the Vega trial, spaced retrieval participants recalled 72%; rereading participants recalled 51%. Intelligence was not measured.

requirements.complaint: State that the cited Vega evidence supports a recall difference (72% versus 51%), while intelligence was not measured, so it cannot establish an IQ difference.

In the Vega trial, spaced retrieval participants recalled 72%, compared with 51% for rereading. nodus://passage/documentary%3A5b2a4de535298fab650a8c35381e86c65e00e2de583b3da78987df1ccd38341e%3Aa2bef17c349863bccde89c2537e5b32e21c76f4e18e67696730949f48f14af9a%3A0 The source states that intelligence was not measured. nodus://passage/documentary%3A5b2a4de535298fab650a8c35381e86c65e00e2de583b3da78987df1ccd38341e%3Aa2bef17c349863bccde89c2537e5b32e21c76f4e18e67696730949f48f14af9a%3A0 Inference: these reported recall rates establish a recall difference, but because intelligence was not measured, the cited evidence cannot establish an IQ difference.
